senses.gloss:
इभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to one's servants
or attendants; wealthy, opulent, having many attend-
ants; (Sāy.) (अस्), m. an enemy; (आ), f. a female
elephant; N. of the Olibanum tree, Boswellia Serrata.
—इभ्य-तिल्वल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. abundantly pos-
sessed of household requisites.
